card.name: Cowboy Hat
card.subject: A cowboy hat with a tall creased crown, a wide brim curled up at both sides and a band around the base of the crown.
card.hero_colors: rich caramel brown with a red band

card.name: Sheriff Star
card.subject: A gold five-pointed sheriff star badge with a small ball on each tip and a raised rim along its edges.

card.name: Harmonica
card.subject: A harmonica: a long silver rectangle with a row of small square holes along the front, curved cover plates at both ends and two gold screws.

card.name: Bandana
card.subject: A bandana: a smooth triangle of cloth with a small knot at the top and a pattern of round dots.
card.hero_colors: rich red cloth, white dots, small yellow knot

card.name: Cowboy Boots
card.subject: A pair of brown leather cowboy boots with stitched shafts, pointed toes and a silver spur on each heel.
card.hero_colors: rich red-brown leather, gold stitching, silver spurs

card.name: Saddle
card.subject: A brown leather saddle with a raised horn, a high back, a stitched seat and two stirrups attached to its sides, resting on a wooden fence rail.
card.hero_colors: rich chestnut brown leather, golden wood fence rail, gold stitching, silver stirrup trim

card.name: Cactus
card.subject: A tall green saguaro cactus with two upward arms and ribbed sides, with a flower on top, growing from sand.
card.hero_colors: rich green with a pink flower

card.name: Covered Wagon
card.subject: A covered wagon with an arched white canvas cover on a wooden bed and four wooden wheels, with a wooden tongue at the front resting on the ground.
card.hero_colors: white canvas, wood brown bed and tongue, red wheel rims

card.name: Windmill
card.subject: A farm windmill: a tall tapering four-sided tower with solid walls, a round wheel of many blades at the top, and a tail vane behind the wheel.
card.hero_colors: rich red-brown tower, white blades, golden yellow tail vane

card.name: Campfire
card.subject: A bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, glowing orange ends on the logs, and warm orange light cast on what stands near it; the logs sit in a ring of grey stones, with a plum enamel coffee pot with a red rim on a flat stone beside it.
card.hero_colors: orange flames, wood brown logs, plum enamel coffee pot with a red rim, small grey stones
card.surface_or_setting: a patch of dry dirt with a ring of stones
